models_evaluated: 4B parameter open-source LLM with LoRA fine-tuning
8B parameter open-source LLM with LoRA fine-tuning

links.outcome: AI model performance for perioperative complication detection compared with human experts on same records
links.effect: State-of-the-art models consistently outperformed human experts; fine-tuned 4B model F1 rose from 0.18 to 0.55 versus human experts' F1=0.526; 8B model F1>0.61.
links.quote: Initial evaluations revealed that state-of-the-art models consistently outperformed human experts, particularly reasoning models.

unlisted_practices: Decomposing comprehensive detection into focused single-complication prompts to improve small-model performance
Using locally deployable open-source LLMs to preserve data sovereignty

screen.reason: Evaluates targeted prompting and LoRA fine-tuning of open-source LLMs against human experts for perioperative complication detection on clinical documentation, focusing on model optimization/performance rather than organizational deployment safeguards.
